Town B is to the south of Town A. Town A is to the east of Town D. Town C is to the north of Town D. Town E is to the west of Town C. What is the position of Town E with respect to Town B?

Each of E, F, G, H, K, L and M has an exam on a different day of a week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. L has an exam on Thursday and F has an exam on Saturday. H has an exam immediately before K. E has an exam on one of the days after G. M has an exam immediately after K. How many people have exams between E and M?

Given below is a statement followed by two possible reasons numbered I and II. Read the statement carefully and decide which of the two reasons explains the event/observation/information given in the statement. Statement:Even though state ABC has given many benefits, subsidies, and relaxation in taxes to industries, many industries have exited the state recently.Reasons:I. Over the past few years, landslides on the main highway of state ABC have increased and authorities are yet to figure out the alternate highway of state ABC.II. The major sources of water for state ABC are drying up, causing reduced water supply in the state ABC.
options: Only II is a possible reason.
Both I and II are possible reasons.
Only I is a possible reason.
Neither I nor II is a possible reason.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Both I and II are possible reasons.) है।

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.) है।

questions.question: Suresh starts from Point M and drives 10 km towards the north. Then he takes a right turn and drives 4 km, he turns right again and drives 4 km. Then he takes a left turn and drives 2 km, then he turns right and drives 8 km. Then he takes a final right turn and drives 6 km and stops at Point N. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point M again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified.)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (2 km towards north) है।
